raw_segments.text: The other was as certainly Georgiana, but not the Georgiana I remembered—the slim
This was a full-blown, very plump damsel, fair as waxwork, with handsome and regular
features, languishing blue eyes, and ring-litted yellow hair.
The hue of her dress was black, too, but its fashion was so different from her sister's,
so much more flowing and becoming it looked as stylish as the others looked puritanical.
